intro: The small words that make a conversation sound native: opening, reacting, digressing, interrupting and winding up.
p.enterarse de: to find out, to hear about
p.total, que.nota: It jumps to the outcome of a story.
p.volver a lo de antes: to get back to what we were saying
p.no tener nada que ver: to have nothing to do (with it)
b1.texto:
**Opening.** **¿Sabes qué?** **¿Sabes lo de** Marta? **¿Te has enterado de** lo de Marta? **Oye, ¿tienes un momento?**

**Asking for the story.** **No, ¿qué ha pasado?** **¡Anda, cuenta!** **Cuéntame algo de** tu viaje.

**Starting it.** **Pues verás…** **Pues nada, que…** **Te cuento.** **El otro día…**

**Reacting.** **¡No me digas!** **¿En serio?** **¡Es increíble!** **¡Es alucinante!** **Ya, me lo imagino.** **Normal.** **Lo entiendo.**

**Checking.** **¿Sabes?** **¿No te parece?**

**Digressing.** **Por cierto…** **A propósito…** **Hablando de** viajes… **Cambiando de tema…** And coming back: **Volviendo a lo de antes…** **¿De qué hablábamos?** **Como decía…**

**Refusing a topic.** **Cambiemos de tema.** **No hablemos de eso, ¿vale?** **Eso no tiene nada que ver.**

**Interrupting.** **Perdona que te interrumpa, pero…** **Antes de que se me olvide…** **Espera, un momento…** Both take the subjunctive: perdona que te **interrumpa**; antes de que se me **olvide**.

**Keeping your turn.** **Espera, déjame terminar.** **Ya termino.** **Como decía…** And giving it: **Adelante, sigue, te escucho.** **Tú primero.**

**Winding up.** **Total, que** al final no fuimos. **En fin…** **Y nada…** **Bueno, pues eso.**
b2.f0: Hey, have you heard about Nacho?
b2.f1: No, what's happened? Come on, tell me!
b2.f2: Well, you see: he's left the bank and gone to live in a village of twenty people.
b2.f3: You don't say! That's amazing. Sorry to interrupt, but what about his wife?
b2.f4: As I was saying, they've both gone. So, in the end, they now have goats and make cheese.
b2.f5: I can imagine it perfectly. By the way, speaking of cheese, before I forget: are you coming to dinner on Friday?
b4.o2.refuerzo: With que you need a conjugated verb.
b5.o0.refuerzo: Antes de que always takes the subjunctive.
b5.o1.refuerzo: Antes de que always takes the subjunctive.
b5.o2.refuerzo: Antes de que always takes the subjunctive.
b6.pregunta: Total, que no fuimos. What does total, que do?
b6.o1.refuerzo: It is a discourse marker, not a sum.
b7.pregunta: You want to return to the earlier topic. You say…
b7.o0.refuerzo: Getting back to what we were saying.
b7.o1.refuerzo: That moves away from the topic.
b8.o0: That has nothing to do with it.
b8.o1.explicacion: No tener nada que ver: to be unrelated.
b8.o2: There is nothing to see there.
b10.traduccion: Before I forget, I have to give you something.
b11.texto:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write a lively dialogue in which someone tells a piece of gossip and the other interrupts, digresses and comes back to the subject.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Tell a piece of news aloud for three minutes, using at least ten conversation markers. Record yourself and listen.
